method: Real Codex in-app browser UI through computer-use / cua_repl. Native accessibility controls and documented Playwright locators; DOM evaluation limited to visible layout measurements. Screenshots captured from the real browser, separately from Skia production frames.

checks.name: Original material and structure assets render in the real game
checks.observed: Overhead rooms, guardians, textured first-person stone corridors, a trap and the shared map are visible.

checks.name: Pause and resume
checks.observed: UI changes between 暂停 and 继续运转 / 开始运转; full-screen pause also changes the actual shared pause state.

checks.name: Enter and return from possession
checks.observed: Guard 1 becomes 亲自控制 with real 110/110 health, build tools become disabled, seven movement/combat controls appear; P restores management and enables construction.

checks.name: Full-screen controls stay accessible
checks.observed: Full-screen stage exposes pause, selected-guard possession, return to management, tool instructions and exit. Enter-guard and pause were activated by pointer; return and exit were additionally verified by keyboard activation of their actual visible buttons.

checks.name: Guided excavation consumes budget and completes
checks.observed: 接通训练场 + canvas Enter reduces 700 gold to 692 and creates one digging task. After starting normal time the queue reaches zero and guard 3 progresses to level 2.

checks.name: Actual reload restores paused state
checks.observed: Reload preserves the current gold, charges, room count and guard levels; restore message appears and resume remains an explicit action.

checks.name: 390 by 844 responsive layout
checks.observed: Document content width 375 <= viewport 390; game stage width 345.33 and height 215.83. All seven on-screen controls stay inside the stage and viewport.

checks.name: Possession scrolls the game into view on a narrow screen
checks.observed: After the sidebar possession action the stage appears at y=313.77 within the 844-high viewport, with health, return and movement controls visible.

checks.name: Desktop layout
checks.observed: Real desktop page and full-screen views were reviewed; a 1440-wide layout has content width 1425 with no horizontal overflow. Temporary viewport overrides were reset afterward.

checks.name: Browser errors
checks.observed: Captured warn/error log inspection returned an empty list.

screenshots.purpose: Actual full-screen shared-world guard view with textured walls, trap, minimap, health and controls.
Actual paused management entrance at the browser's restored default narrow sizing.
Actual 390-wide responsive guard view after automatic game positioning.

fixes_from_review: Added in-stage full-screen actions so management controls remain available.
Moved actual management statistics above the map to avoid overlap with full-screen actions.
Removed duplicate embedded view/health instructions that overlapped the minimap and controls.
Automatically positions the game after entering possession on narrow screens.
Corrected the guard/miner count label and named the guided objective 接通训练场.
remaining: Real phone hardware multitouch, orientation changes and mobile browser full-screen behaviour have not been validated; callback tests cover multiple pointer identities and cancellation.
No sustained performance profiling or broad browser/device compatibility claim.
Human emotional appeal, replay intention and commercial product readiness remain unverified.
